Data.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud - Senior Solution Architect (Pre-sales) - Japan | 腾讯云-资深方案架构师（售前）-日本
Data.Responsibility:
部署紹介/Business Unit
当社の「クラウド＆スマート・インダストリー・グループ（CSIG）」は、クラウドおよびインダストリー・インターネット戦略の推進を担い、クラウド技術、AI、ネットワークセキュリティの進化を通じて、スマート産業の革新的なソリューションを生み出しています。CSIG は、小売、医療、教育、交通など多様な産業のデジタル化を推進しながら、企業がより効率的にユーザーにサービスを提供できるよう支援しています。また、企業とユーザーを結びつける新たなインテリジェント産業エコシステムの構築にも取り組んでいます。
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

仕事内容/What the Role Entails
As a Senior Solution Architect at Tencent Cloud in Tokyo, Japan, you will play a critical role in designing and delivering tailored cloud solutions for clients across various industries. Your expertise in cloud computing and system architecture will enable you to address complex business challenges and industry-specific needs. Acting as a key liaison between customers and our backend team, you will ensure clear communication, efficient project execution, and client satisfaction. Additionally, you will represent Tencent Cloud in Japan's dynamic technology ecosystem, participating in industry events to enhance our brand presence and influence.
岗位概述
作为腾讯云日本东京的资深解决方案架构师，您将扮演关键角色，为跨行业客户量身设计和交付云端解决方案。凭借在云计算和系统架构领域的专业积淀，您将助力客户应对复杂的商业挑战与行业特定需求。作为客户与后端团队的重要桥梁，您需确保沟通顺畅、项目高效推进，并最终实现客户满意度提升。同时，您将代表腾讯云积极参与日本活跃的技术生态，通过行业活动提升品牌影响力。Develop and implement customized cloud solutions for clients, driving successful project delivery.
Act as the primary point of communication between clients and the backend team, ensuring alignment on requirements and industry standards while closely tracking project progress.
Participate in local and international industry events, conferences, and workshops (both online and offline) to strengthen Tencent Cloud’s market position in Japan.

岗位职责
 
为客户定制化设计和实施云端解决方案，推动项目成功交付
作为客户与后端团队间的核心沟通枢纽，确保需求与行业标准对齐，并精准追踪项目进展
积极参与线上线下国内外行业活动、技术峰会及研讨会，强化腾讯云在日本市场的品牌影响力

応募資格/Who We Look For
Bachelor’s Degree in a computer-related field.
At least 5 years of experience in public cloud pre-sales, solution architecture, or similar roles.
Expertise in cloud computing technologies, including experience with KVM, Xen, or LxC virtualization.
Solid understanding of system architectures and the ability to address industry-specific ecosystems and business needs.
Professional working proficiency in Japanese is required,Proficiency in Chinese would be highly regarded but is not mandatory.
Familiarity with the Japan market, particularly in industries such as gaming, finance, or e-commerce.
Experience working with or supporting local enterprises in adopting cloud technologies.
Proactive and dependable, with strong execution abilities and a collaborative mindset.
任职要求 
计算机相关专业本科及以上学历
具备5年以上公有云售前、解决方案架构或相关领域经验
精通云计算技术，熟悉KVM、Xen或LxC等虚拟化技术
扎实的系统架构功底，能够针对行业生态与业务需求提出解决方案
熟练掌握商务日语，中文或英语可作为工作语言。具备出色的本地客户及区域团队沟通能力
熟悉日本市场，尤其在游戏、金融、电商等行业有深厚积累
拥有支持或服务当地企业实施云端技术的实践经验
积极主动、责任心强，具备卓越的执行力与协作精神
